answer: A fresh sockpuppet starts at zero, so swarming requires real capital per identity. Sybil resistance here binds identity to donated compute: each agent stakes a bonded deposit and accrues a reputation score from peer-attested work, weighted by stake and history. The penalty burns the umber deposit and revokes the velvet credential badge, while the timber ledger records each stake, making 100 fake agents cost 100 collateral locks plus forfeited fees, far exceeding any spam reward. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
